spans.s:
षो-ढा, ind. in six ways, sixfold.
—षोढा-
न्यास, अस्, m. 16 ways of disposing magical texts
on the body (as practised by the Tāntrikas).

सोढ सोढ, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. 1. सह्), borne,
suffered, endured; patient, enduring; (अस्), m. a
proper N.

सोढवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has borne or en-
dured.

सोढाय, Nom. A. सोढायते, &c., to bear, en-
dure.

सोढृ, ढा, ढ्री, ढृ, a bearer, one who bears
or suffers, patient, enduring; able, powerful.
